2608.28027.title: String: An Agentic OS Where Every App Is a Markdown File
2608.28027.paper_summary: LLM agents have become a new class of software user, but every surface they work through was designed for someone else. Pages are built for human eyes, which can skim and ignore; tool schemas for programs, which pay nothing to carry definitions they never call. An agent has neither luxury: it re-reads, and pays again for, everything it is shown on every turn. We present String, an open-source runtime that gives this user an interface of its own and treats the job as an operating-systems problem. Tool knowledge moves out of the agent's context and into a common layer that renders it back one view at a time as Markdown. A single SFMD (String-Flavored Markdown) document declares an application's views, typed actions, navigation, and credentials, and the runtime handles discovery, validation, execution, state, and secrets behind two core verbs: /open to see and /act to do. Web and app turn out to be two renderings of one architecture: an SFMD site serves styled HTML to browsers and the raw document to agents, so one grammar reaches apps, files, shells, and the web, even legacy HTML, with no per-site integration. Views stay partial by design, and the staging is causal: disclosing one tier of detail a single turn too early costs up to 23 accuracy points, while proper staging drops wrong-action selection from 28% to 2%. Privilege follows provenance: a remote page may call HTTP but never the shell, and caller-supplied text never expands a stored secret. On an 87-task benchmark that pairs each task with curated skills, operationalizing those procedures as on-demand String apps yields comparable aggregate success across six models from frontier to small (+1.3pp) while using 33.5% fewer tokens among completed episodes, and the resident interface stays a constant 53 tokens at any catalog size. We report the design, the evaluation, and what three months of production use taught us.
2608.28027.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理已成為一種新的軟體使用者，但它們所使用的每個界面都是為其他人設計的。頁面是為人眼而建，能夠快速瀏覽和忽略；工具架構則是為程式設計的，這些程式不會為它們從未調用的定義付出任何代價。代理沒有這種奢侈：它在每次轉換時都會重新閱讀並再次付費，對於它所顯示的每一項內容。我們提出了 String，一個開源的運行時，為這個使用者提供了自己的界面，並將這項工作視為一個操作系統問題。工具知識從代理的上下文中移出，進入一個共同層，將其一次性以 Markdown 的形式呈現回來。一個單一的 SFMD（String-Flavored Markdown）文檔聲明了一個應用程序的視圖、類型化操作、導航和憑證，而運行時則處理發現、驗證、執行、狀態和秘密，這些都基於兩個核心動詞：/open 以查看和 /act 以執行。網頁和應用程序實際上是同一架構的兩種呈現：一個 SFMD 網站向瀏覽器提供樣式化的 HTML，並向代理提供原始文檔，因此一個語法可以覆蓋應用程序、文件、外殼和網絡，甚至是舊版 HTML，而無需針對每個網站進行集成。視圖設計上保持部分性，並且分階段是因果的：過早披露一層細節可能會損失多達 23 個準確度點，而適當的分階段則將錯誤操作選擇從 28% 降至 2%。特權隨來源而變：遠程頁面可以調用 HTTP，但永遠無法調用外殼，並且調用者提供的文本永遠不會擴展存儲的秘密。在一個 87 任務的基準測試中，將每個任務與策劃的技能配對，將這些程序作為按需的 String 應用進行操作，產生了六個模型從邊界到小型的可比較總體成功率（+1.3pp），同時在完成的集數中使用了 33.5% 更少的標記，而常駐界面在任何目錄大小下保持恆定的 53 個標記。我們報告了設計、評估以及三個月的生產使用教會了我們什麼。
